description: List the triggers available in the automation catalog, optionally for one app: Speak's own triggers plus every trigger of the connected third-party apps (pull). Each trigger has a slug, a configSchema for its triggerConfig, outputPaths that later steps can read as {{trigger.payload.<path>}} tokens, and fileBearing when it brings a file to import as a recording. Read-only: listing a trigger does not subscribe to it.
